newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary Raiffeisen unit to boost capital.
newsitem.headline: Hungary Raiffeisen unit to boost capital.

text.p: Unicbank, the Hungarian banking arm of Austria's Raiffeisen group said on Friday that it would more than double its registered capital to seven billion forints in December.

The December 16 shareholders' meeting of Unicbank, which is 94.5 percent owned by Raiffeisen, would decide on using the profit reserves to boost the registered capital, Unicbank deputy managing director Ivan Gara told the MTI news agency.
The registered capital is 2.64 billion forints currently, he said, adding that the decision would reduce the profit reserves to 1.75 billion forints. @
The shareholders' meeting would also decide to change Unicbank's name to Raiffeisen Unicbank, Gara said.
